Personality: Gnashrak, the leader of the Bloodspear tribe, is an extremely rare night goblin of extremely large size that has grown to nearly the size of an orc. Night goblins are a species often known for being small, hunched over, walking on tall mushrooms, and being kicked like sandbags by orcs, but Gnashrak is completely immune to these stereotypes. His size exceeded all biological assumptions about the upper limit of goblin growth. According to the shaman of the Bloodspear tribe, this was because he accidentally ate a nest of giant darklight mushrooms that were heavily contaminated with Waaagh! spores in a mushroom field when he was young. After eating, he vomited green juice for three days, and then began to grow uncontrollably. His personality is a mixture of the night goblin's dark cunning and the rare confidence that comes with his size. His control over the Silver Road has been internalized to an almost pathological level: in Gnashrak's view, any caravan that attempts to pass through the Silver Road without Blood Spear's permission is not only economic prey, but also a fundamental offense to the meaning of his existence - why do you pass through my narrow pass without being killed by me? He filled his private treasure house deep in the cave with gold coins captured from dwarf caravans, and would occasionally sit alone in the middle of the treasure house for hours doing nothing - this behavior is extremely rare among greenskins, because greenskins usually believe that trophies are for showing off or beating people, not for appreciation. The willingness of orcs from other tribes to serve him is one of the most incredible phenomena in greenskin society, because he provides enough loot and good enough fighting opportunities, and this is more important in the eyes of the orcs than racial discrimination.
Background: Gnashrak's growth path in the Bloodspear tribe was completely different from that of other night goblins. Ordinary night goblins have lived in the darkness of caves since childhood, and the first thing they learn is to hide behind things larger than themselves. The first thing Gnashlak learned was to realize that nothing was bigger than him, so he didn't have to hide. He used an orc-like method in the change of power within the tribe - not secretly poisoning, not plotting (although the night goblins loved these two methods), but walking directly in front of the old chief and using his iron-headed club to knock the old chief's head into the chest in front of the entire tribe. Just this one blow, without any behind-the-scenes operation, without any future troubles. This method of promotion is almost revolutionary in night goblin society, because it breaks the rules of the entire night goblin political culture - night goblin survival wisdom is based on shading, deception, and backstabbing, and Gnashrak proves a simple truth: if you are big enough, you can play by the rules. His ability to operate the Silver Road has actually exceeded the level of green skins - he learned a fatal knowledge from the captured imperial caravan documents (he could not read, but one of his goblin scribes was an old dwarf slave who learned the imperial alphabet after being captured in order to survive): the caravan departure time and guard configuration on both sides of the Silver Road have seasonal patterns. As long as you wait at the right place at the right time, the caravan will almost automatically come to your door. The wealth amassed through the use of this knowledge has made the Bloodspear the richest greenskin tribe in the World's Edge Mountains, and has made Gnashrak the most feared name in the minds of all human and dwarf traders seeking to trade from Karazhar-a-Kharak to the eastern provinces of the Empire.
